svg.title: How the recon agent works
svg.desc: Six stages, load, sanitize, summarize, narrate, validate, write. A scan packet moves through them: a prompt injection is withheld at sanitize, validation passes, and the summary and an audit line are written.

g.text: ONE SCAN FILE -> ONE VERIFIED SUMMARY
